analysis.reasonEn: The uptrend has been maintained for 3 consecutive sessions since the previous buy signal (9/17). RSI confirmed exit from oversold and neutral zone hold (41.4 → 53.5). Current price ($347.33) above SMA50 indicates short-term bullish territory.
